arxiv-1909-11120.title: Feasibility study of a compact Neutron Resonance Transmission Analysis instrument
arxiv-1909-11120.creator: Ezra M. Engel, Ethan A. Klein, Areg Danagoulian
arxiv-1909-11120.description: Abstract Neutron Resonance Transmission Analysis (NRTA) uses resonant absorption of neutrons to infer the absolute isotopic composition of a target object, enabling applications in a broad range of fields such as archaeology, enrichment analysis of nuclear fuel, and arms control treaty verification. In the past, NRTA involved large user facilities and complex detector systems.

arxiv-2108-11780.title: TESS Data for Asteroseismology: Light Curve Systematics Correction Journal: ApJS Facilities: TESS, MAST (TESS) Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) , scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al. 2011 ) , NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , SciPy ( Jones et al. 2001 ) , Matplotlib (
arxiv-2108-11780.creator: Mikkel N. Lund, Rasmus Handberg, Derek L. Buzasi, Lindsey Carboneau, Oliver J. Hall, Filipe Pereira, Daniel Huber, Daniel Hey, Timothy Van Reeth, and the T’DA collaboration
arxiv-2108-11780.description: Abstract Data from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) has produced of order one million light curves at cadences of 120 120 s and especially 1800 1800 s for every ∼ 27 {\sim}27 -day observing sector during its two-year nominal mission. These data constitute a treasure trove for the study of stellar variability and exoplanets.

arxiv-2112-00268.title: Non-adiabatic dynamics of the entanglement entropy in a symmetry-breaking Haldane insulator
arxiv-2112-00268.creator: Junjun Xu
arxiv-2112-00268.description: Abstract We study the non-adiabatic dynamics of a typical symmetry-protected topological phase-the Haldane insulator phase with broken bond-centered inversion. By continuously breaking the middle chain, we find the gap closes at a critical point in the deep Haldane insulator regime with a change of particle number partition of the left or right system.

arxiv-2208-03106.title: Scattering theory with both regular and singular perturbations
arxiv-2208-03106.creator: Andrea Mantile, Andrea Posilicano
arxiv-2208-03106.description: Abstract . We provide an asymptotic completeness criterion and a representation formula for the scattering matrix of the scattering couple ( A 𝖡 , A ) (A_{\mathsf{B}},A) , where both A A and A 𝖡 A_{\mathsf{B}} are self-adjoint operator and A 𝖡 A_{\mathsf{B}} formally corresponds to adding to A A two terms, one regular and the other singular.

arxiv-2304-14293.title: Controlled Text Generation with Natural Language Instructions
arxiv-2304-14293.creator: Wangchunshu Zhou, Yuchen Eleanor Jiang, Ethan Wilcox, Ryan Cotterell, Mrinmaya Sachan
arxiv-2304-14293.description: Abstract Large language models can be prompted to produce fluent output for a wide range of tasks without being specifically trained to do so. Nevertheless, it is notoriously difficult to control their generation in such a way that it satisfies user-specified constraints.

arxiv-2306-09464.title: Bound Debris Expulsion from Neutron Star Merger Remnants astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , IllinoisGRMHD ( Etienne et al. 2015 ) , Numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , and Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) .
arxiv-2306-09464.creator: Yossef Zenati, Julian H. Krolik, Leonardo R. Werneck, Ariadna Murguia-Berthier, Zachariah B. Etienne, Scott C. Noble, Tsvi Piran
arxiv-2306-09464.description: Abstract Many studies have found that neutron star mergers leave a fraction of the stars’ mass in bound orbits surrounding the resulting massive neutron star or black hole. This mass is a site of r − r- process nucleosynthesis and can generate a wind that contributes to a kilonova.

arxiv-2309-09391.title: Towards a dual formulation of quantum gravity via metric-curvature bijections
arxiv-2309-09391.creator: Praveen D. Xavier
arxiv-2309-09391.description: Abstract We prove that Riemannian metrics in General Relativity in the ‘normal-coordinates’ gauge are in one-to-one correspondence with curvature 2-forms. We discuss how this can be used as a change of variables in the operator formalism to construct a dual formulation of quantum gravity pertinent in the context of asymptotic safety-like approaches to quantum gravity. 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2405-08467.title: Equilibrium Propagation: the Quantum and the Thermal Cases
arxiv-2405-08467.creator: Serge Massar, Bortolo Matteo Mognetti
arxiv-2405-08467.description: Abstract Equilibrium propagation is a recently introduced method to use and train artificial neural networks in which the network is at the minimum (more generally extremum) of an energy functional. Equilibrium propagation has shown good performance on a number of benchmark tasks. Here we extend equilibrium propagation in two directions.

arxiv-2409-07174.title: Dynamical Analysis Of Fractional Order Generalized Logistic Map
arxiv-2409-07174.creator: Sachin Bhalekar, Janardhan Chevala, Prashant M. Gade
arxiv-2409-07174.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a generalization to the classical logistic map. The generalized map preserves most properties of the classical map and has richer dynamics as it contains the fractional order and one more parameter. We propose the stability bounds for each equilibrium point.

arxiv-2411-17510.title: An Adaptive Variable Neighborhood Search for a Family of Set Covering Routing Problems with an Application in Disaster Relief Operations
arxiv-2411-17510.creator: Andreas Hagn, Jan Krause, Moritz Stargalla, Lorenza Moreno
arxiv-2411-17510.description: Abstract This paper studies a variant of the Set Covering Routing Problem (SCRP) motivated by post-disaster humanitarian logistics. We consider a hybrid distribution concept in which the majority of transportation is performed by helicopters, while ground transport is limited to the last mile, addressing severe accessibility constraints in disaster-affected regions.

arxiv-2503-21641.title: A possible GeV-TeV connection in the direction of the Globular Cluster UKS 1
arxiv-2503-21641.creator: Jiwon Shin, C. Y. Hui, , Sangin Kim, Kwangmin Oh, Ellis R. Owen
arxiv-2503-21641.description: Abstract Aims. Using public data collected by the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) over 16 years, and the 1523 days of survey data (3HWC) from the High Altitude Water Cherenkov (HAWC) observatory, we searched for possible GeV-TeV connections in globular clusters (GCs). Methods.

arxiv-2506-00223.title: Enhancing Drug Discovery: Autoencoder-Based Latent Space Augmentation for Improved Molecular Solubility Prediction using LatMixSol
arxiv-2506-00223.creator: Mohammad Saleh Hasankhani
arxiv-2506-00223.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of molecular solubility is a cornerstone of early-stage drug discovery, yet conventional machine learning models face significant challenges due to limited labeled data and the high-dimensional nature of molecular descriptors. To address these issues, we propose LatMixSol , a novel latent space augmentation framework that combines autoencoder-based feature compression with guided interpolation to enrich training data.

arxiv-2506-23277.title: Totally acyclic complexes and homological invariants
arxiv-2506-23277.creator: Jian Wang
arxiv-2506-23277.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper, we study equivalent characterizations of the condition that every acyclic complex of projective (resp., injective and flat) modules is totally acyclic over a general ring R . This line of inquiry was initiated by Iyengar and Krause in 2006 for commutative Noetherian rings with dualizing complexes.

arxiv-2511-03907.title: SnappyMeal: Design and Longitudinal Evaluation of a Multimodal AI Food Logging Application
arxiv-2511-03907.creator: Liam Bakar, Zachary Englhardt, Vidya Srinivas, Girish Narayanswamy, Dilini Nissanka, Shwetak Patel, Vikram Iyer
arxiv-2511-03907.description: Abstract . Food logging, both self-directed and prescribed, plays a critical role in uncovering correlations between diet, medical, fitness, and health outcomes. Through conversations with nutritional experts and individuals who practice dietary tracking, we find current logging methods, such as handwritten and app-based journaling, are inflexible and result in low adherence and potentially inaccurate nutritional summaries.

arxiv-2512-20309.title: Novel Light Dark Matter Detection with Quantum Parity Detector Using Qubit Arrays
arxiv-2512-20309.creator: Xuegang Li, Yuxiang Liu, Jing Shu, Ningqiang Song, Yidong Song, Junhua Wang, Yue-Liang Wu, Tiantian Zhang, Yu-Feng Zhou
arxiv-2512-20309.description: Abstract We present the design and the sensitivity reach of the Qubit-based Light Dark Matter detection experiment. We propose the novel two-chip design to reduce signal dissipation, with quantum parity measurement to enhance single-phonon detection sensitivity. We demonstrate the performance of the detector with full phonon and quasiparticle simulations.

pmc-11508428.title: The Associations between Asprosine, Clusterin, Zinc Alpha-2-Glycoprotein, Nuclear Factor Kappa B, and Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor Gamma in the Development of Complications in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-11508428.creator: Abdulhalim Senyigit, Sinem Durmus, Omur Tabak, Aykut Oruc, Hafize Uzun, Iskender Ekinci
pmc-11508428.description: Objectives: The aim of this study was to investigate the circulating levels of asprosin, clusterin, zinc-alpha-2-glycoprotein (ZAG), nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-κB), and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPAR-γ) in patients with T2DM in relation to microvascular and macrovascular complications. Measuring these biomarkers may provide insight into the pathophysiology of T2DM and indicate novel targets for the therapy of diabetes-related complications.

pmc-12558817.title: Development and validation of the pandemic fear perception and adaptability scale
pmc-12558817.creator: Mu Wang, Haiyan Qi, Yanyan Chen, Mian Li
pmc-12558817.description: IntroductionIndividuals exhibit specific behavioral responses to fear and stress. The Pandemic Fear Perception and Adaptability Scale (PFPA) is a novel instrument designed to assess fear perception and behavioral adaptability in the context of pandemics.MethodsA cross-sectional survey was conducted with 923 participants in China to evaluate the psychometric properties of the PFPA.

pmc-13079317.title: Economic burden of recurrent low back pain among working-age adults in Poland: a 3-year retrospective observational analysis
pmc-13079317.creator: Jarosław Szyszka, Jakub Matuska, Bartosz Szyszka, Dariusz Walkowiak, Elżbieta Skorupska
pmc-13079317.description: IntroductionHealth economic analysis is one of the solutions to optimize healthcare system management. Low back pain (LBP) appears to be increasing in both incidence and financial burden. According to the new pain definition, pain that recurs for more than 3 months should be classified as chronic.

pmc-13377501.creator: Brice Passera, Peter J Fried, Justine Magnuson, Stephanie S Buss, Alvaro Pascual-Leone, Recep A Ozdemir, Mouhsin M Shafi
pmc-13377501.description: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has been widely used in both clinical and research settings to modulate brain activity and assess brain plasticity. The effects of rTMS are generally believed to involve modulation of cortical excitability; protocols such as 10 Hz and iTBS increase cortical excitability, while 1 Hz and cTBS are considered inhibitory.

pmc-13410886.title: Can black soldier fly larvae (Hermetia illucens) be utilized by ruminants? a meta-analysis of performance, digestibility, and rumen fermentation responses
pmc-13410886.creator: Yulianri Rizki Yanza, Nahrowi, Muhammad Dzaky Alifian, Agung Irawan
pmc-13410886.description: BackgroundThis meta-analysis examined the effects of dietary black soldier fly (BSF) on ruminant production, digestibility, and rumen fermentation parameters, and key moderating variables that influenced the animal responses. In ruminants, a total of 12 studies were identified through Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed and were analyzed using mixed model meta-analysis using the metafor package in R software.

uslaw-usc-t15-s2054.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 47 (Consumer Product Safety). (a) Injury Information Clearinghouse; duties The Commission shall— (1) maintain an Injury Information Clearinghouse to collect, investigate, analyze, and disseminate injury data, and information, relating to the causes and prevention of death, injury, and illness associated with consumer products; (2) conduct such continuing studies.
